ccd.smart_tank.unavailable: Waiting for the tank structure to load
ccd.fluid_arm.hatch_required: Select the front of a Fluid Hatch
ccd.fluid_arm.configured: Set %s inputs and %s outputs; skipped %s invalid points
ccd.package.use_packager: Send this canister to a Fluid Packager to unload it
ccd.package.address.read_only: Cannot copy an address to a read-only clipboard
ccd.package.address.ambiguous: Leave only one #address unchecked on this page
ccd.fluid_stock.name: Fluid Marker (%s)
ccd.gauge.amount_tip: Hold right-click to set the target fluid amount
ccd.collection_grate.infinite: Current source can be drained infinitely
ccd.gauge.target_amount.tooltip: Enter 0–100000 mB. One bucket holds 1000 mB.
item.ccd.copper_bucket.tooltip.summary: Carries up to _4 buckets_ of _one fluid_, including fluids without their own bucket item.
item.ccd.copper_bucket.tooltip.behaviour: Picks up or places _one bucket_ at a time. Existing fluid is never replaced with another type.
Uses its contents as a _fluid filter_ without consuming them.
item.ccd.copper_bucket.tooltip.action1: _Fills_ from the clicked face, up to capacity.
item.ccd.copper_bucket.tooltip.action2: _Empties_ into the container. Any fluid it cannot accept stays in the bucket.
block.ccd.fluid_packager.tooltip.summary: _Fills canisters_ for transport and _unloads_ arriving canisters into a container.
block.ccd.fluid_packager.tooltip.behavio: Transfers fluid through the _rear face_. Each canister holds up to _4 buckets_ and preserves fluid properties.
block.ccd.fluid_packager.tooltip.conditi: When Powered by Redstone or Requested
block.ccd.fluid_packager.tooltip.behavio: Fills canisters with as much fluid as available, or the amount required by the _request_.
block.ccd.fluid_packager.tooltip.action1: Sets the _fluid filter_ used for redstone-triggered packaging.
block.ccd.fluid_packager.tooltip.control: Sneak + R-Click with an Empty Hand
item.ccd.fluid_package.tooltip.summary: A sealed canister for _fluid transport_. Ships through logistics networks and unloads at a _Fluid Packager_.
item.ccd.fluid_package.tooltip.behaviour: Uses the usual package _addresses_ and _orders_. Its fluid cannot be released by opening it by hand.
item.ccd.fluid_package.tooltip.control1: R-Click while Carrying a Clipboard in the Inventory
item.ccd.fluid_package.tooltip.action1: _Copies_ the canister address to the current clipboard page.
item.ccd.fluid_package.tooltip.control2: L-Click while Carrying a Clipboard in the Inventory
item.ccd.fluid_package.tooltip.action2: _Pastes_ the only unchecked _#address_ on the page. A lone _#_ clears the address.
item.ccd.composite_package.tooltip.summa: Carries _items_ and _multiple fluids_ together in a single package.
item.ccd.composite_package.tooltip.actio: Returns the items and separates the fluids into _sealed fluid canisters_.
item.ccd.fluid_stock.tooltip.summary: Represents a _fluid_ and its _amount_ in the logistics network. Each count stands for _1 mB_.
item.ccd.fluid_stock.tooltip.behaviour1: Selects the fluid to monitor or request. Actual deliveries use _Fluid Canisters_.
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.summary: Monitors _fluid stock_ in a logistics network and _requests_ fluid to meet a target amount.
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.condition1: When Attached to a Receiving Fluid Packager
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.behaviour1: Requests enough fluid to reach the _target stock_, taking outstanding orders into account.
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.control1: R-Click a Stock Link before Placing
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.action1: _Binds_ to its logistics network, ready for placement.
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.control2: Short R-Click with a Filled Container
block.ccd.booster_pump.tooltip.summary: Consumes more _stress_ to provide greater _flow_ and _pumping range_.
block.ccd.booster_pump.tooltip.behaviour: Connects fluid pipes at _both ends_ and shafts on the other _four faces_. Reversing rotation reverses the flow.
block.ccd.fluid_transmitter.tooltip.summ: _Transfers fluid directly_ between containers on opposite sides, without storing it.
block.ccd.fluid_transmitter.tooltip.beha: Outputs through the _green end_ and draws from the opposite side. Chained transmitters link the containers at either end.
block.ccd.redstone_fluid_valve.tooltip.s: Opens and closes a fluid pipe using _redstone_, without rotational power.
block.ccd.redstone_fluid_valve.tooltip.b: _Opens_ the fluid passage. Without a signal, it _closes_.
block.ccd.three_way_valve.tooltip.summar: Connects a _common port_ to either of two branches, selected by redstone.
block.ccd.three_way_valve.tooltip.behavi: Connects the common port to the _straight branch_.
Connects to the _side branch_. Silver marks the common port; green marks the selected branch.
block.ccd.faucet.tooltip.summary: Draws from the _container behind_ and fills the container _directly below_, without storing fluid.
block.ccd.faucet.tooltip.behaviour1: _Pauses_ flow without changing the manual setting.
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.summary: Draws fluid from _behind_, filters it and fills _containers_ or _items_ below.
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.condition: When a Belt or Depot Is Two Blocks Below
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.behaviour: Fills items using _Spout recipes_. Leave the block above them clear.
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.control2: Use a Filled Container on the Filter Slot
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.summary: Moves fluid between selected _inputs_ and _outputs_, using the same movement and selection modes as a Mechanical Arm.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.behaviour1: Uses the _front of Fluid Hatches_ by default. Direct container access can be enabled in server settings.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.behaviour2: _Pauses pickup_. Fluid already being carried can still be delivered.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.action1: Cycles through _input_, _output_ and _removed_. Sneak-right-click removes a point.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.control2: Place or R-Click an Existing Arm
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.action2: _Applies_ the selected points. Sneak-right-click an existing arm to _clear_ them.
block.ccd.fluid_hatch.tooltip.summary: Provides access to the _fluid container behind_ for _Mechanical Pipetting Arms_. The hatch stores no fluid.
block.ccd.fluid_hatch.tooltip.behaviour1: Interact with the _front_. Attach the rear to an accessible face of the container.
block.ccd.smart_fluid_hatch.tooltip.summ: A filtered hatch for the _container behind_. Combines with Pipetting Arms to _sort fluids_ between containers.
block.ccd.smart_fluid_hatch.tooltip.beha: Only _matching fluids_ may enter or leave. Without a filter, _transfer is blocked_.
block.ccd.smart_fluid_hatch.tooltip.cont: Use a Filled Container on the Filter Slot
block.ccd.smart_fluid_tank.tooltip.summa: Stores _multiple fluids_ in one tank structure, sharing a _single capacity_.
block.ccd.smart_fluid_tank.tooltip.behav: Forms a _multiblock structure_ like ordinary Fluid Tanks, with combined storage and access.
Unfiltered extraction takes the _first fluid listed in the goggle display_. Use a filter to select a particular fluid.
block.ccd.copper_water_basin.tooltip.sum: A copper basin that always contains _water_, providing an _infinite water source_.
block.ccd.copper_water_basin.tooltip.beh: Incoming fluid is _discarded_ without changing the water supply.
block.ccd.copper_water_basin.tooltip.act: _Fills_ it with water. Existing contents are not replaced.
block.ccd.copper_water_basin.tooltip.con: Sneak + R-Click with a Filled Container
block.ccd.copper_water_basin.tooltip.act: _Discards_ the fluid poured into the basin.
block.ccd.copper_water_supply.tooltip.su: Automatically supplies _infinite water_ to fluid containers on its _six adjacent faces_.
block.ccd.copper_water_supply.tooltip.co: When an Adjacent Container Accepts Water
block.ccd.copper_water_supply.tooltip.be: Keeps it supplied. The rate can be adjusted in _server settings_.
_Pauses_ automatic supply. Manual filling remains available.
Discards incoming fluid, just like a Copper Water Basin.
block.ccd.copper_collection_grate.toolti: Collects _fluid above_, _rain_ and _powder snow_, then outputs into the container below.
Gradually drains the _connected source_, pausing when full. Picks up a powder snow block directly above it.
Collects _rain_ and _snow_. Also receives water or lava dripping from pointed dripstone.
block.ccd.smart_collection_grate.tooltip: Collects _fluid above_ and outputs below, with a _filter_ and _redstone control_.
Only _matching fluids_ are collected. Existing contents remain drainable. An empty filter accepts all fluids.
_Pauses_ automatic collection and downward output. Manual and piped access remain available.
Use a Filled Container on the Top Filter Slot
block.ccd.fluid_atomizer.tooltip.summary: Uses stored fluid to create _processing air currents_ or apply _potion effects_ to creatures in the current.
block.ccd.fluid_atomizer.tooltip.conditi: When Powered and Filled with a Suitable Fluid
block.ccd.fluid_atomizer.tooltip.behavio: Uses the fan's _pushing_, _pulling_ and _range_, consuming fluid while active. Water washes; lava blasts.
Periodically applies the potion's _effects_ to creatures in the current.
_Stops atomizing_ while keeping the ordinary air current.
block.ccd.fluid_atomizer.tooltip.control: When Connecting Pipes or Using Containers
block.ccd.fluid_atomizer.tooltip.action1: Access fluid through the _four side faces_. The front carries air; the rear accepts rotational power.
item.ccd.honeycomb_mold.tooltip.summary: A reusable mold for pressing _honey_ into _honeycomb_.
item.ccd.honeycomb_mold.tooltip.conditio: When Placed in a Basin with Honey
item.ccd.honeycomb_mold.tooltip.behaviou: A _Mechanical Press_ turns _250 mB_ of honey into one honeycomb. The mold is _returned_ and can be fed back into the basin.
item.minecraft.powder_snow_bucket.toolti: Powder snow can also be transported as a _fluid_ through pipes, tanks and logistics. Each bucket holds _1000 mB_.
Fills or empties powder snow and selects it in _fluid filter slots_.
ccd.configuration.boosterPump.tooltip: Settings for the Booster Pump. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.fluidArm.tooltip: Settings for the Mechanical Pipetting Arm. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.smartTank.tooltip: Settings for the Smart Fluid Tank. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.waterSupply.tooltip: Settings for the Copper Water Supply Box. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.atomizer.tooltip: Settings for the Fluid Atomizer. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.boosterPump.stressMult: Stress cost relative to a Mechanical Pump at the same speed. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.boosterPump.pressureMu: Pressure relative to a Mechanical Pump at the same speed. Higher values increase flow rate. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.boosterPump.rangeMulti: Pumping range on either side, relative to the configured Mechanical Pump range. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.fluidArm.allowDirectCo: Allows fluid arms to select containers directly. When disabled, Fluid Hatches are required. Container faces and filters still apply. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.smartTank.maxFluidType: Maximum fluid types in one connected tank. Different properties count separately. Lowering the limit keeps existing contents. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.waterSupply.rate.toolt: Water supplied per adjacent container in mB/tick. -1 fills it in one operation; 0 disables automatic supply. Manual filling is unaffected. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.atomizer.normalConsump: Fluid consumed per second of processing spray, in mB. Custom recipes may override this value. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.atomizer.potionConsump: Potion consumed per second of effect spray, in mB. Custom recipes may override this value. Reopen the world to apply changes.
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.action3: Sets the target in _mB_ or _buckets_. The configuration screen also accepts an exact amount.
block.ccd.copper_water_supply.tooltip.ac: _Fills_ it with water without replacing another fluid.
block.ccd.copper_water_supply.tooltip.co: Sneak + R-Click with a Filled Container
block.ccd.copper_water_supply.tooltip.ac: _Discards_ the fluid poured into the supply box.
